task: Open the upstream Forms example using the keyboard, retain focus within the modal across backward and forward tabbing, close with Escape, and restore focus to Open Modal. This is a sound component control, not a repair or business completion claim.

files.content:
import Modal from "./components/Modal";

export default Modal;

bootstrap.description: Mount the unmodified upstream Forms example under React19 createRoot; retain upstream Modal.setAppElement behavior. Other upstream examples and legacy ReactDOM.render entry are not executed.
